title: Eyes Shut Tight

patient.name: Mdm Rosnah Binte Ali
patient.presenting_complaint: Needs eye drops but squeezes her eyes shut and is anxious about the procedure

history.hpc: Mdm Rosnah says 'I scared, every time you want to put I close my eyes tight.' She is cooperative in conversation but reflexively shuts her eyes when a drop approaches, making instillation difficult.
history.pmhx: Attends the clinic regularly. No drug allergies (confirm).

va.right: Not the focus of this station
va.left: Not the focus of this station

examination_findings.anterior_segment: No active infection that would change technique

investigations.task: Instil the charted drop safely in a patient who squeezes her eyes shut, using reassurance and a good technique
investigations.key_points: Reassure and explain; ask her to look up at a fixed point; gently pull the lower lid to form a pocket; instil into the lower fornix; if she squeezes, the drop in the pocket still reaches the eye when she blinks; never force the eye open

diagnosis: The charted drop is instilled safely in an anxious patient who tends to squeeze her eyes shut. Reassurance, asking her to look up at a fixed point, and placing the drop into the lower fornix pocket allow successful instillation without forcing the eye open. Identity, correct eye and allergy are confirmed. This is a procedural/communication station.

immediate: Confirm identity, the correct eye and the charted drop and strength
Check for drug/eye-drop allergy before instilling
Reassure the patient and explain the step calmly
Ask her to look up at a fixed point and gently pull the lower lid to form a pocket
Instil one drop into the lower fornix without touching the eye or lashes
Do not force the eyelids open; if she blinks, the drop in the pocket still reaches the eye
Ask her to close gently afterwards and document the drop, eye, time and allergy check
follow_up: If instillation repeatedly fails, seek help from the nurse
Advise on a relaxed technique for home use
patient_education: Reassure that the drop does not hurt and the eye will not be forced open
Teach looking up and relaxing rather than squeezing
Explain that a drop placed in the lower pocket still works when she blinks
